title: Exact finite verification of the valley-normalized local insertion lemma

definitions.canonical_seam: c0(h) is the smallest original column attaining min(h). L_c0(r,c)=r*n+((c-c0) mod n), with zero-based layers.
definitions.local_parent_formula: For m=(r,c), r>0, newly maximal parents after deleting m are (r-1,c-1) when (r,c-1) is absent and (r-1,c) when (r,c+1) is absent; the parent columns lie in {c-1,c}.
definitions.consecutive_parent_difference: max(I\\{ma})\\max(I\\{mb}) = {mb} union (new_parents(ma)\\new_parents(mb)); reverse the roles for the opposite difference.
definitions.sign_change_operationalization: For each local pair, align the cut vectors by decreasing parent label. Independently test the sign variation of the constant and t coefficients of w(ma)-w(mb); each must have at most one sign change. This is the finite criterion reported here, not a proof of an unrestricted theorem.
definitions.branden_pair_test: For every ordered pair f,g in the proposed sequence, require real nonpositive roots, degree difference at most one, and an exact positive-semidefinite standard coefficient Bezoutian B(g,f) when labels decrease. This fixes the sign convention under reversal of the label order.
definitions.C35_critical_witness_definition: The four valid height vectors (3,a,b,2,3), a,b in {1,2}, whose maximum-height block crosses the original seam.
